universe.UST10Y_FUT: US Treasury ETF (proxy: 10y futures price, no coupon)

spec.period: 2001-01-02 .. 2026-11-06; returns as in V8 (6-sigma roll filter)
spec.trend: long/flat: hold the asset if the sum of its last 252 daily returns > 0, else cash (0% return)
spec.hold: benchmark: always hold every asset (same risk sizing, no trend filter)
spec.sizing: raw w_i = 0.15 / sigma_i(60d) / 4; if sum of raw weights over held assets > 1, scale them down to sum 1 (no leverage)
spec.rebalance: every 21st union-calendar day from closes, applied from the next day
spec.costs: 0.10% per unit turnover (discounted commission + 0.1% ETF sell tax, halved per side) + 0.40%/year holding cost on invested weight
spec.primary: annualised Sharpe of trend minus hold; one-sided p from 5000 calendar-year block bootstrap draws (share with difference <= 0); pass if p < 0.05

ownerContext: owner capital about NT$1M or less
